scope: Initial targeted editorial review, not an exhaustive background check. Exclude documented serious violence, sexual misconduct, child/partner abuse and animal cruelty supported by pleas, findings, admissions, video or NFL discipline. An exclusion is not a claim of criminal conviction. Mere arrest, rumor, substance use or unpopular opinions are not sufficient. Recheck disputed cases before adding. Match stable player IDs, never names alone. At owner request, serious allegations documented in reputable reporting and formal civil proceedings can also justify editorial omission; label disputed allegations and settlements explicitly, without inferring guilt.
